rule: The primary-document review status records only a bounded original-passage scope comparison, not complete bilingual text collation or certification. All 55 original debates remain uncertified; editorial objections are not quotations.

stages.source_locator_scope: Veritatis Splendor §§78–80; Aquinas I-II q18 aa2–4; Planned Parenthood consent page is contextual
stages.finding_en: Consent is a necessary condition; the cited consent advice is not an argument that consent is sufficient for Catholic moral goodness.
stages.finding_fr: Le consentement est nécessaire ; la page citée n'affirme pas qu'il suffit à assurer la bonté morale catholique.

stages.source_locator_scope: Veritatis Splendor §§78–80; Aquinas I-II q18 aa2–4; Planned Parenthood consent page is contextual
stages.finding_en: Coercion is a grave injustice; this concession should not be attributed to a source as a complete sexual ethic.
stages.finding_fr: Le caractère grave de la contrainte ne fait pas du consentement une morale sexuelle complète.

stages.source_locator_scope: Veritatis Splendor §§78–80; Aquinas I-II q18 aa2–4; Planned Parenthood consent page is contextual
stages.finding_en: An act may be freely chosen and nevertheless morally defective by object; see I-II q18.
stages.finding_fr: Un acte librement voulu peut rester mauvais par son objet : voir I-II q.18.

stages.source_locator_scope: Veritatis Splendor §§78–80; Aquinas I-II q18 aa2–4; Planned Parenthood consent page is contextual
stages.finding_en: Veritatis Splendor §§78–80 explicitly rejects reducing moral goodness to aims or consequences.
stages.finding_fr: Veritatis Splendor §§78–80 refuse de réduire la bonté morale aux fins ou aux conséquences.

stages.source_locator_scope: Veritatis Splendor §§78–80; Aquinas I-II q18 aa2–4; Planned Parenthood consent page is contextual
stages.finding_en: Consent to adultery cannot remove an existing obligation of fidelity: moral inference from object and justice.
stages.finding_fr: Consentir à l'adultère ne supprime pas le devoir de fidélité : inférence morale sur l'objet et la justice.

stages.source_locator_scope: Veritatis Splendor §§78–80; Aquinas I-II q18 aa2–4; Planned Parenthood consent page is contextual
stages.finding_en: The example of unattached adults is an authored challenge, not a quoted Planned Parenthood passage.
stages.finding_fr: Le cas de deux adultes libres est une objection rédigée, non une citation de Planned Parenthood.

stages.source_locator_scope: Veritatis Splendor §§78–80; Aquinas I-II q18 aa2–4; Planned Parenthood consent page is contextual
stages.finding_en: The answer turns on moral object and conjugal goods, not personal freedom alone.
stages.finding_fr: La réponse porte sur l'objet moral et les biens conjugaux, non seulement sur la liberté.

stages.source_locator_scope: Veritatis Splendor §§78–80; Aquinas I-II q18 aa2–4; Planned Parenthood consent page is contextual
stages.finding_en: Necessity of consent and sufficiency for moral rectitude remain logically different claims.
stages.finding_fr: Consentement nécessaire et suffisance pour la rectitude morale restent deux affirmations différentes.

stages.source_locator_scope: Fletcher passages reproduced by John Murray, Situation Ethics, criticism §§1–2; Veritatis Splendor §§78–83
stages.finding_en: Fletcher's claim about agape as a supreme norm is attested through quotations in John Murray's critique, not a full direct check of his book.
stages.finding_fr: L'agapè comme seule norme est attestée par les citations de Fletcher chez John Murray, sans vérification du livre intégral.

stages.source_locator_scope: Fletcher passages reproduced by John Murray, Situation Ethics, criticism §§1–2; Veritatis Splendor §§78–83
stages.finding_en: The secondary review explicitly prints Fletcher's claim that loving conduct is morally right in the situation.
stages.finding_fr: La critique secondaire reproduit une affirmation précise de Fletcher sur l'acte le plus aimant.

stages.source_locator_scope: Fletcher passages reproduced by John Murray, Situation Ethics, criticism §§1–2; Veritatis Splendor §§78–83
stages.finding_en: Aquinas on act and will permits good intentions without endorsing every chosen means.
stages.finding_fr: Saint Thomas admet l'importance d'une bonne intention sans justifier tout moyen choisi.

stages.source_locator_scope: Fletcher passages reproduced by John Murray, Situation Ethics, criticism §§1–2; Veritatis Splendor §§78–83
stages.finding_en: Veritatis Splendor §§78–80 states a good end cannot render an intrinsically evil object good.
stages.finding_fr: Veritatis Splendor §§78–80 refuse qu'une fin bonne rende bon un objet intrinsèquement mauvais.

stages.source_locator_scope: Fletcher passages reproduced by John Murray, Situation Ethics, criticism §§1–2; Veritatis Splendor §§78–83
stages.finding_en: Object, intention and circumstances are distinct dimensions, not mutually exclusive ones.
stages.finding_fr: Objet, intention et circonstances sont distincts sans être séparés dans l'acte.

stages.source_locator_scope: Fletcher passages reproduced by John Murray, Situation Ethics, criticism §§1–2; Veritatis Splendor §§78–83
stages.finding_en: The question about inseparability is a reasoned hypothetical; Fletcher's original wording was not checked.
stages.finding_fr: La question sur leur inséparabilité est construite ; elle n'est pas une citation de Fletcher.

stages.source_locator_scope: Fletcher passages reproduced by John Murray, Situation Ethics, criticism §§1–2; Veritatis Splendor §§78–83
stages.finding_en: Different means to a good end require distinct judgments about what is deliberately chosen.
stages.finding_fr: Plusieurs moyens poursuivant une même fin demandent des jugements moraux distincts.

stages.source_locator_scope: Fletcher passages reproduced by John Murray, Situation Ethics, criticism §§1–2; Veritatis Splendor §§78–83
stages.finding_en: Intentions matter but cannot turn an evil moral object good.
stages.finding_fr: L'intention importe mais ne transforme pas un objet mauvais en bien.

stages.source_locator_scope: Fletcher excerpts in Murray's critique; Veritatis Splendor §§79–83; Aquinas I-II q18
stages.finding_en: Fletcher's situationist exception claim is traceable only through selected author excerpts in an adverse critic's essay.
stages.finding_fr: La thèse situationniste de Fletcher n'est accessible ici qu'à travers des extraits cités par un critique.

stages.source_locator_scope: Fletcher excerpts in Murray's critique; Veritatis Splendor §§79–83; Aquinas I-II q18
stages.finding_en: Compassion and context can be important, but quotations do not establish an absolute clinical inference.
stages.finding_fr: La compassion et le contexte comptent sans constituer une démonstration clinique générale.

stages.source_locator_scope: Fletcher excerpts in Murray's critique; Veritatis Splendor §§79–83; Aquinas I-II q18
stages.finding_en: Veritatis Splendor distinguishes objectively evil object from the culpability of a particular agent.
stages.finding_fr: Veritatis Splendor distingue objet mauvais et culpabilité d'une personne.

stages.source_locator_scope: Fletcher excerpts in Murray's critique; Veritatis Splendor §§79–83; Aquinas I-II q18
stages.finding_en: An exception based solely on circumstances does not alter intrinsic moral specification.
stages.finding_fr: Une exception tirée des circonstances ne modifie pas l'espèce morale intrinsèque.

stages.source_locator_scope: Fletcher excerpts in Murray's critique; Veritatis Splendor §§79–83; Aquinas I-II q18
stages.finding_en: Intrinsically wrong refers to the object chosen, not identical guilt for all persons.
stages.finding_fr: « Intrinsèquement mauvais » qualifie l'objet choisi, non une culpabilité identique pour tous.

stages.source_locator_scope: Fletcher excerpts in Murray's critique; Veritatis Splendor §§79–83; Aquinas I-II q18
stages.finding_en: The request for proof rather than assertion is an illustrative challenge, not Fletcher's direct question.
stages.finding_fr: La demande de démonstration est une contre-objection illustrative, non la question littérale de Fletcher.

stages.source_locator_scope: Fletcher excerpts in Murray's critique; Veritatis Splendor §§79–83; Aquinas I-II q18
stages.finding_en: Calling an act intrinsically evil requires a warranted account of its moral object.
stages.finding_fr: Qualifier l'acte exige une justification de son objet moral, non une simple étiquette.

stages.source_locator_scope: Fletcher excerpts in Murray's critique; Veritatis Splendor §§79–83; Aquinas I-II q18
stages.finding_en: Objective prohibition and subjective responsibility must never be conflated.
stages.finding_fr: Interdiction objective et responsabilité subjective ne doivent pas être confondues.

cases.topic: Christ's teaching and later moral applications

stages.source_locator_scope: 1986 CDF letter to Curran, list of disputed subjects; Scripture Mt 5:27–32; Mt 19:3–12; 1 Cor 6:9–20
stages.finding_en: The CDF's letter lists disputed sexual doctrines; it does NOT attribute a 'Jesus never mentioned it' thesis to Curran.
stages.finding_fr: La lettre CDF énumère des positions discutées ; elle n'attribue PAS à Curran l'argument « Jésus ne l'a jamais dit ».

stages.source_locator_scope: 1986 CDF letter to Curran, list of disputed subjects; Scripture Mt 5:27–32; Mt 19:3–12; 1 Cor 6:9–20
stages.finding_en: The absence of modern terminology from Gospels is an observation, not an original Curran thesis.
stages.finding_fr: L'absence de termes modernes des Évangiles est un constat, pas une thèse originale vérifiée de Curran.

stages.source_locator_scope: 1986 CDF letter to Curran, list of disputed subjects; Scripture Mt 5:27–32; Mt 19:3–12; 1 Cor 6:9–20
stages.finding_en: Whether a modern practice is named is separate from its moral properties and Scriptural principles.
stages.finding_fr: L'absence du nom d'une technique se distingue de sa portée morale et des principes scripturaires.

stages.source_locator_scope: 1986 CDF letter to Curran, list of disputed subjects; Scripture Mt 5:27–32; Mt 19:3–12; 1 Cor 6:9–20
stages.finding_en: Christian moral teaching is not limited to exact nouns used in the Gospels; this is a theological inference.
stages.finding_fr: La morale chrétienne dépasse les seuls termes évangéliques : c'est une inférence théologique.

stages.source_locator_scope: 1986 CDF letter to Curran, list of disputed subjects; Scripture Mt 5:27–32; Mt 19:3–12; 1 Cor 6:9–20
stages.finding_en: Jesus discusses adultery and marriage, Paul bodily holiness; each specific modern extension needs proof.
stages.finding_fr: Jésus enseigne sur l'adultère et le mariage, Paul sur le corps ; l'application moderne doit être démontrée.

stages.source_locator_scope: 1986 CDF letter to Curran, list of disputed subjects; Scripture Mt 5:27–32; Mt 19:3–12; 1 Cor 6:9–20
stages.finding_en: The worry about importing later prejudices is an authored counterquestion, not Curran's verified wording.
stages.finding_fr: Le soupçon de préjugés tardifs est une contre-objection construite, pas une formule attestée de Curran.

stages.source_locator_scope: 1986 CDF letter to Curran, list of disputed subjects; Scripture Mt 5:27–32; Mt 19:3–12; 1 Cor 6:9–20
stages.finding_en: An extension from Scripture requires an argued analogy with the chosen act, not lexical identity.
stages.finding_fr: Appliquer l'Écriture suppose un raisonnement sur l'acte choisi, non une identité lexicale.

stages.source_locator_scope: 1986 CDF letter to Curran, list of disputed subjects; Scripture Mt 5:27–32; Mt 19:3–12; 1 Cor 6:9–20
stages.finding_en: A missing ancient term neither entails permission nor entails prohibition.
stages.finding_fr: L'absence d'un mot antique ne prouve ni permission ni interdiction.

stages.source_locator_scope: Curran 1987, history of manuals and sexual theology; 1 Cor 6:12–20; 1 Thess 4:3–8
stages.finding_en: Curran's 1987 text addresses the history of Catholic sexual-ethical argument, not this verbatim statement about Paul's culture.
stages.finding_fr: L'article de Curran examine l'histoire de la morale sexuelle, non cette formule littérale sur la culture de Paul.

stages.source_locator_scope: Curran 1987, history of manuals and sexual theology; 1 Cor 6:12–20; 1 Thess 4:3–8
stages.finding_en: The critical observation about ancient culture must be distinguished from an attributed published claim.
stages.finding_fr: La contextualisation de l'Antiquité ne doit pas être présentée comme une citation d'auteur.

stages.source_locator_scope: Curran 1987, history of manuals and sexual theology; 1 Cor 6:12–20; 1 Thess 4:3–8
stages.finding_en: Pauline texts have literary and cultural contexts; what follows morally must be argued.
stages.finding_fr: Les textes pauliniens ont un contexte culturel ; la conséquence morale doit être argumentée.

stages.source_locator_scope: Curran 1987, history of manuals and sexual theology; 1 Cor 6:12–20; 1 Thess 4:3–8
stages.finding_en: Historic context alone cannot demonstrate that a claim was meant only for that context.
stages.finding_fr: Le seul contexte historique ne démontre pas qu'une norme soit limitée à son époque.

stages.source_locator_scope: Curran 1987, history of manuals and sexual theology; 1 Cor 6:12–20; 1 Thess 4:3–8
stages.finding_en: Paul appeals to belonging to Christ and holiness; that is not merely etiquette.
stages.finding_fr: Paul évoque l'appartenance au Christ et la sainteté, non de simples convenances.

stages.source_locator_scope: Curran 1987, history of manuals and sexual theology; 1 Cor 6:12–20; 1 Thess 4:3–8
stages.finding_en: The ancient-anthropology counterquestion is authored rather than quoted from Curran.
stages.finding_fr: La contre-question sur l'anthropologie antique est construite, non citée de Curran.

stages.source_locator_scope: Curran 1987, history of manuals and sexual theology; 1 Cor 6:12–20; 1 Thess 4:3–8
stages.finding_en: The force of Paul's theological reason remains a distinct question from his era's customs.
stages.finding_fr: La portée d'une raison théologique se distingue des coutumes de son siècle.

stages.source_locator_scope: Curran 1987, history of manuals and sexual theology; 1 Cor 6:12–20; 1 Thess 4:3–8
stages.finding_en: Contextual study is necessary, but age of the text is not itself a refutation.
stages.finding_fr: L'étude du contexte est nécessaire, mais l'ancienneté n'est pas une réfutation.

stages.source_locator_scope: Curran 1987, Vatican II and manual tradition; Veritatis Splendor §§78–83; Casti Connubii
stages.finding_en: Curran's original essay explicitly discusses development at Vatican II and continuity in sexual ethics.
stages.finding_fr: Le texte original de Curran discute des changements conciliaires et de la continuité en morale sexuelle.

stages.source_locator_scope: Curran 1987, Vatican II and manual tradition; Veritatis Splendor §§78–83; Casti Connubii
stages.finding_en: Historical changes in formulations and disciplines are relevant, but do not entail any exact contradiction.
stages.finding_fr: Les changements de formulations et de discipline comptent sans prouver une contradiction précise.

stages.source_locator_scope: Curran 1987, Vatican II and manual tradition; Veritatis Splendor §§78–83; Casti Connubii
stages.finding_en: Changing discipline or wording is not identical to reversal of an intrinsic moral norm.
stages.finding_fr: Un changement de pratique n'est pas le renversement d'une norme morale intrinsèque.

stages.source_locator_scope: Curran 1987, Vatican II and manual tradition; Veritatis Splendor §§78–83; Casti Connubii
stages.finding_en: A claim of contradiction must concern the same moral object and level of doctrinal assertion.
stages.finding_fr: Une contradiction alléguée doit viser le même objet moral et un jugement doctrinal comparable.

stages.source_locator_scope: Curran 1987, Vatican II and manual tradition; Veritatis Splendor §§78–83; Casti Connubii
stages.finding_en: Casti Connubii supplies one primary continuity witness, not a proof of all centuries.
stages.finding_fr: Casti Connubii constitue un témoin primaire de continuité, non la preuve de tous les siècles.

stages.source_locator_scope: Curran 1987, Vatican II and manual tradition; Veritatis Splendor §§78–83; Casti Connubii
stages.finding_en: The charge of selective evidence is an illustrative skeptical question, not an original Curran quotation.
stages.finding_fr: L'accusation de sélection des sources est une question critique construite, non une citation de Curran.

stages.source_locator_scope: Curran 1987, Vatican II and manual tradition; Veritatis Splendor §§78–83; Casti Connubii
stages.finding_en: The revised answer tests doctrinal reversal against matching act, circumstances and authority.
stages.finding_fr: La réponse révisée confronte le même acte, ses circonstances et le degré d'autorité.

stages.source_locator_scope: Curran 1987, Vatican II and manual tradition; Veritatis Splendor §§78–83; Casti Connubii
stages.finding_en: Development is compatible with enduring norms, unless an actual opposed proposition is demonstrated.
stages.finding_fr: Développement et normes durables coexistent tant qu'une proposition contraire n'est pas prouvée.

stages.source_locator_scope: Aquinas I-II q19 aa5–6; Donum Veritatis §§23–31; Curran 1987 on dissent
stages.finding_en: Curran's original article supports the fact of dissent, not the exact assertion that any sincere conscience makes an act right.
stages.finding_fr: Curran atteste le dissentiment, non la thèse littérale que toute conscience sincère rend l'acte bon.

stages.source_locator_scope: Aquinas I-II q19 aa5–6; Donum Veritatis §§23–31; Curran 1987 on dissent
stages.finding_en: The appeal to conscientious judgment has a real basis without equating sincerity and truth.
stages.finding_fr: Le jugement de conscience importe sans identifier sincérité et vérité.

stages.source_locator_scope: Aquinas I-II q19 aa5–6; Donum Veritatis §§23–31; Curran 1987 on dissent
stages.finding_en: Aquinas I-II q19 aa5–6 distinguishes a conscience judgment from the truth of its object.
stages.finding_fr: Saint Thomas I-II q19 aa5–6 distingue le jugement de conscience de la vérité de son objet.

stages.source_locator_scope: Aquinas I-II q19 aa5–6; Donum Veritatis §§23–31; Curran 1987 on dissent
stages.finding_en: Donum Veritatis §28 explicitly rejects an autonomous conscience as doctrinal arbiter.
stages.finding_fr: Donum Veritatis §28 rejette expressément la conscience comme arbitre doctrinal autonome.

stages.source_locator_scope: Aquinas I-II q19 aa5–6; Donum Veritatis §§23–31; Curran 1987 on dissent
stages.finding_en: Donum Veritatis §§23–31 permits responsible inquiry with continuing obligation toward authority.
stages.finding_fr: Donum Veritatis §§23–31 admet une recherche loyale sous l'obligation due à l'autorité.

stages.source_locator_scope: Aquinas I-II q19 aa5–6; Donum Veritatis §§23–31; Curran 1987 on dissent
stages.finding_en: The 'make it agree with Church' question is authored, not verbatim Curran.
stages.finding_fr: La question « s'accorder avec l'Église » est construite, non une citation de Curran.

stages.source_locator_scope: Aquinas I-II q19 aa5–6; Donum Veritatis §§23–31; Curran 1987 on dissent
stages.finding_en: The revised reply states authentic Magisterium is not a mere optional opinion; serious difficulties may still be investigated.
stages.finding_fr: La réponse précise que le Magistère authentique n'est pas une simple opinion tout en admettant les difficultés.

stages.source_locator_scope: Aquinas I-II q19 aa5–6; Donum Veritatis §§23–31; Curran 1987 on dissent
stages.finding_en: An erroneous conscience remains possible despite sincere conviction.
stages.finding_fr: Une conscience sincère peut néanmoins être erronée.

stages.source_locator_scope: Donum Veritatis §§23–31 and §§32–41; Curran 1987 original essay
stages.finding_en: Curran's 1987 essay documents actual dissent, not the exact claim that disagreement makes moral options free.
stages.finding_fr: L'essai de Curran manifeste un dissentiment réel, non la thèse littérale que la divergence libère tout choix.

stages.source_locator_scope: Donum Veritatis §§23–31 and §§32–41; Curran 1987 original essay
stages.finding_en: Expert disagreement matters as evidence of debate, but is not itself a doctrinal ruling.
stages.finding_fr: Le désaccord d'experts indique un débat, non un jugement doctrinal.

stages.source_locator_scope: Donum Veritatis §§23–31 and §§32–41; Curran 1987 original essay
stages.finding_en: Donum Veritatis §24 explicitly recognizes some prudential magisterial judgments may be defective.
stages.finding_fr: Donum Veritatis §24 reconnaît que certains jugements prudentiels peuvent être imparfaits.

stages.source_locator_scope: Donum Veritatis §§23–31 and §§32–41; Curran 1987 original essay
stages.finding_en: Donum Veritatis §28 distinguishes serious difficulty from rejection based only on contrary probability.
stages.finding_fr: Donum Veritatis §28 distingue difficulté sérieuse et rejet fondé sur une simple opinion probable.

stages.source_locator_scope: Donum Veritatis §§23–31 and §§32–41; Curran 1987 original essay
stages.finding_en: Donum Veritatis §§23–31 distinguishes grades of teaching and the proper response.
stages.finding_fr: Donum Veritatis §§23–31 distingue les degrés de magistère et leurs exigences.

stages.source_locator_scope: Donum Veritatis §§23–31 and §§32–41; Curran 1987 original essay
stages.finding_en: The rhetorical case of differing theologians is illustrative rather than an author quote.
stages.finding_fr: Le cas des théologiens divisés est illustratif, non une citation.

stages.source_locator_scope: Donum Veritatis §§23–31 and §§32–41; Curran 1987 original essay
stages.finding_en: Persistent theological difficulty does not by itself imply definitive teaching is optional.
stages.finding_fr: Une difficulté persistante ne rend pas facultatif tout enseignement définitif.

stages.source_locator_scope: Donum Veritatis §§23–31 and §§32–41; Curran 1987 original essay
stages.finding_en: The teaching's authority, not a count of scholars, determines the ecclesial obligation.
stages.finding_fr: L'autorité de l'enseignement compte davantage que le nombre de théologiens.

stages.source_locator_scope: Aquinas I-II q77 aa6–7; q78 a2; Catechism §2352; NIDA substance addiction only
stages.finding_en: The NIDA source addresses substance addiction, not a verified sexual-addiction diagnosis.
stages.finding_fr: Le texte NIDA traite des drogues, non d'un diagnostic vérifié de dépendance sexuelle.

stages.source_locator_scope: Aquinas I-II q77 aa6–7; q78 a2; Catechism §2352; NIDA substance addiction only
stages.finding_en: Compulsion as a phenomenon is relevant, but analogy between drugs and sex needs separate evidence.
stages.finding_fr: La compulsion importe, mais l'analogie entre substances et sexualité exige d'autres preuves.

stages.source_locator_scope: Aquinas I-II q77 aa6–7; q78 a2; Catechism §2352; NIDA substance addiction only
stages.finding_en: Aquinas I-II q77 a6–7 explains diminished culpability through antecedent passion.
stages.finding_fr: Saint Thomas I-II q77 aa6–7 étudie la diminution de responsabilité par passion antécédente.

stages.source_locator_scope: Aquinas I-II q77 aa6–7; q78 a2; Catechism §2352; NIDA substance addiction only
stages.finding_en: Aquinas I-II q78 a2 distinguishes habit possessed from deliberate action by habit.
stages.finding_fr: Saint Thomas I-II q78 a2 distingue l'habitude possédée de l'acte choisi selon l'habitude.

stages.source_locator_scope: Aquinas I-II q77 aa6–7; q78 a2; Catechism §2352; NIDA substance addiction only
stages.finding_en: The revised argument avoids treating every entrenched habit as fully involuntary.
stages.finding_fr: La révision évite d'assimiler toute habitude à une absence de volonté.

stages.source_locator_scope: Aquinas I-II q77 aa6–7; q78 a2; Catechism §2352; NIDA substance addiction only
stages.finding_en: The measurement objection is an illustrative challenge not stated by NIDA.
stages.finding_fr: La difficulté de mesurer la culpabilité est une objection illustrative, non une thèse NIDA.

stages.source_locator_scope: Aquinas I-II q77 aa6–7; q78 a2; Catechism §2352; NIDA substance addiction only
stages.finding_en: Judgment of a specific person's culpability requires careful knowledge and freedom distinctions.
stages.finding_fr: La culpabilité individuelle exige un examen prudent de la connaissance et de la liberté.

stages.source_locator_scope: Aquinas I-II q77 aa6–7; q78 a2; Catechism §2352; NIDA substance addiction only
stages.finding_en: A habit may mitigate, leave intact or aggravate culpability depending on how chosen.
stages.finding_fr: Une habitude peut diminuer, laisser intacte ou aggraver la culpabilité selon le choix.

stages.source_locator_scope: Freud 1908 original essay Modern Sexual Morality and Modern Nervousness; Aquinas II-II q151 a1; Sacra Virginitas
stages.finding_en: Freud directly criticizes contemporary restrictions and their alleged link to nervous illness, not chastity as Thomistic virtue in exact wording.
stages.finding_fr: Freud critique les restrictions de son époque et leurs effets supposés, non la vertu thomiste sous ces mots.

stages.source_locator_scope: Freud 1908 original essay Modern Sexual Morality and Modern Nervousness; Aquinas II-II q151 a1; Sacra Virginitas
stages.finding_en: Some formation can be distressing; Freud's thesis must not be inflated into a measured universal outcome.
stages.finding_fr: Une formation peut causer de la détresse ; Freud ne fournit pas une mesure universelle de cet effet.

stages.source_locator_scope: Freud 1908 original essay Modern Sexual Morality and Modern Nervousness; Aquinas II-II q151 a1; Sacra Virginitas
stages.finding_en: Aquinas II-II q151 a1 locates chastity under temperance rather than condemnation of desire.
stages.finding_fr: Saint Thomas II-II q151 a1 place la chasteté sous la tempérance, non la négation du désir.

stages.source_locator_scope: Freud 1908 original essay Modern Sexual Morality and Modern Nervousness; Aquinas II-II q151 a1; Sacra Virginitas
stages.finding_en: Self-governance is not identical with indiscriminate suppression: moral inference from virtue's object.
stages.finding_fr: La maîtrise de soi diffère de la suppression indistincte : inférence sur l'objet de la vertu.

stages.source_locator_scope: Freud 1908 original essay Modern Sexual Morality and Modern Nervousness; Aquinas II-II q151 a1; Sacra Virginitas
stages.finding_en: Aquinas q151 and Sacra Virginitas distinguish virtue from fear or disdain for the body.
stages.finding_fr: Saint Thomas et Sacra Virginitas distinguent la vertu de la peur ou du mépris du corps.

stages.source_locator_scope: Freud 1908 original essay Modern Sexual Morality and Modern Nervousness; Aquinas II-II q151 a1; Sacra Virginitas
stages.finding_en: The psychological-harm challenge is a reasoned extrapolation, not Freud's exact question.
stages.finding_fr: L'objection clinique est une extrapolation raisonnable, non une question littérale de Freud.

stages.source_locator_scope: Freud 1908 original essay Modern Sexual Morality and Modern Nervousness; Aquinas II-II q151 a1; Sacra Virginitas
stages.finding_en: The updated response concedes suffering without treating all chastity as clinically pathological.
stages.finding_fr: La réponse admet la souffrance sans assimiler toute chasteté à une pathologie.

stages.source_locator_scope: Freud 1908 original essay Modern Sexual Morality and Modern Nervousness; Aquinas II-II q151 a1; Sacra Virginitas
stages.finding_en: Virtuous chastity governs the sexual appetite rather than abolishing it.
